identity.intro: Create your administrator account. Your organization becomes active after you verify your email.
identity.websiteHint: Use your HTTPS root website, e.g. https://company.com.
identity.passwordHint: Use 10–128 characters, including at least one uppercase letter and one special character.
identity.roleHint: Your professional role does not affect your administrator access.
identity.correctFields: Please correct the required fields above.
identity.unavailable: The service could not complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
identity.rolesError: The professional roles could not be loaded.
identity.pending: Our email provider has accepted the verification email. Check your inbox and spam folder. Delivery may take a few minutes. Use the latest link; it expires after 24 hours.
identity.verifiedHint: Your email is verified. Opening your organization…
identity.verifyHint: Your verification link signs you in and opens your organization automatically.
identity.invalidLink: This link is missing or invalid. Open the full link from your latest email, or request a new one below.
identity.cooldown: You can request another email in {{seconds}} seconds.
identity.adminReady: You are the organization administrator. Team invitations and member management will be available in a later update.
identity.loginRequired: Log in with a verified account to access your organization.
identity.failedDelivery: The last email attempt failed. We will retry automatically. An earlier link, if any, is unchanged.
identity.queued: Your registration is saved and your verification email is queued. We will send it shortly. Your organization remains inactive until you verify your email.
identity.deliveryCancelled: This email request is no longer available. Log in if you have verified your account, or register with another organization.
identity.emailLocked: This is the email saved with your registration. It cannot be changed here.

errors.password: Create a password with at least 10 characters, one uppercase letter, and one special character.

invitations.title: Bring your team together.
invitations.denied: Log in as a verified organization administrator to invite team members.
invitations.eyebrow: A shared space starts with your people
invitations.intro: Invite colleagues to your organization, one email at a time. Work or personal addresses are welcome.
invitations.formHint: All you need is their email address.
invitations.invalid: Enter a valid email address, up to 254 characters.
invitations.failed: The invitation could not be sent. Please try again.
invitations.uncertain: We could not confirm the result. Check the send status before trying again. If it remains in progress, contact support.
invitations.footer: Invitations expire after seven days. Your colleague will set up their own account when they accept. Pending invitations do not reserve an active-account slot.
invitations.pendingHint: Resending and managing pending invitations will be available in a future update. Your existing invitation remains unchanged.
invitations.loadFailed: We could not load your account. Please try again.
invitations.historyHint: Saved invitations for your organization, newest first.
invitations.historyError: Previous invitations could not be loaded. Please try again.
